title: KNX group-address catalog
description: Maps KNX group addresses to human names, DPTs, and ETS metadata (room, space_path, function, description, writable).

space_path.description: ETS Building tree from the top down to the space of the GA's Function, numbering stripped like room; the last element is room.

writable.description: ETS Write flag on a linked communication object: something on the bus receives this address. Not a permission — a consumer that gates writes must add its own knowledge of which addresses are command inputs. Optional so catalogs generated before this field stay valid.
